description: Abstract class for loan charge events used in testing messaging within the Fineract project. Implements methods to retrieve data class and ID extractor for loan charge data.

classes.name: AbstractLoanChargeEvent
classes.description: Abstract class implementing Event interface for LoanChargeDataV1, providing data class type and ID extraction method.

methods.name: getDataClass
methods.description: Returns the class object of LoanChargeDataV1.

methods.name: getIdExtractor
methods.description: Returns a function to extract the ID from LoanChargeDataV1 instances.
